text:
maya: Hey team — nightly-refresh-sweeper hung again, stuck on 'compact-db' step. Noticed at 00:12 UTC.
maya: Logs show repeated S3 503s and a long pause before the janitor lock is acquired.
maya: Paste logs:
```
2026-03-16T00:11:54Z compacter: acquiring lock for shard-17
2026-03-16T00:12:02Z s3: PutObject failed 503 slow-down
2026-03-16T00:12:02Z compacter: retrying (backoff 10s)
2026-03-16T00:13:45Z compacter: lock timeout exceeded, aborting
```
rick: @maya saw this. Was an infra deploy around 00:10? ops-bot reported network flaps in us-west-2.
rick: Could be S3 throttling from snapshots spillover.
ci-bot: rerun scheduled: nightly-refresh-sweeper job #482 triggered by rick — ETA ~2m :robot_face: 
chloe: If rerun fails again can we force split the shard and run compact on subset? I can run the split script.
maya: +1. Also want to capture full profiler if it stalls again. Flags: --profiler=on --compact-timeout=300
ops: Re: deploys — there was a rolling update to storage-proxy at 00:09, rollback at 00:18. I'll check proxy logs.
maya: Thanks. tagging for bisect: @chloe @rick — if rerun is green, can one of you mark as recovered and close the ticket? If red, start bisect on snapshots that started at 23:50.
chloe: Rerun looks started.
ci-bot: Job #482 status: FAILED after 5m. Exit code 1. Attaching last 10 lines:
```
Error: shard-17: failed to upload compacted archive: PutObject 503
caused by: slow down
```
maya: Looks same. Can someone try manual compact on node-47 with smaller batch size? command:
```
./compact --shard=17 --batch=2000 --s3-timeout=60
```
rick: I'll try manual now, will post output.
rick: manual compact succeeded (nodes kept alive) but upload still got intermittent 503s. Ops suggesting retry/backoff tweak.
ops: Filed storage-proxy ticket #SP-2983. They suspect upstream S3 rate-limiting from snapshot backfills.
maya: For now I'll add a cron retry wrapper to exponential backoff and bump timeout. PR incoming.
maya: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/compare/compact-retry — adds backoff + profiler flag
chloe: Nice. Once merged can we schedule a canary run on shard 1 before promoting? small window needed.
maya: yes. I'll coordinate with ops for a quiet window 01:30-02:00 UTC.
rick: leaving note: follow-up to triage in monday standup. :spiral_calendar:
ops-bot: incident created SP-2983 (priority: P2) — assigned to storage team.
maya: thanks all. closing thread for now, will update after canary.
